name: Level Up!
text: React: Play when you defeat a mission: This super permanently gains +1 accuracy, and +1 damage per attack (each damage type). You may play only one Level Up! per completed mission.

name: Resilient
text: React: Play when your super is hit by an attack: Reduce the attack's damage by 1 (minimum 1) for each damage type. Reduce the damage by an additional point (minimum 1) if this super is a tanker

name: Combined Attack
text: Action: Perform two consecutive Actions, one from a power on your hero and one from a power on your hero's sidekick.

name: Quick Learner
text: React: Play when putting into play a power or enhancement that has a requirement: Reduce the number of cards required by one. Powers reduced to zero requirement still require the powerset.

name: Power Mastery
text: Action: Rotate a power 2 clicks (180 degrees) in either direction.

name: Secret Identity
text: When this card is discarded as the result of an opponent's card effect (not to pay a cost), the opponent must discard 3 cards.

name: Increased Hold
text: React: Play when your super hits with an attack that includes a stun or immobilize: Increase the duration of the status effect by 2 actions.

name: Exemplar
text: Action: Play a sidekick from your hand, even if you already have a sidekick in play.

name: Siphon Power
text: Action: Your hero suffers up to 5 points of damage (this damage cannot be resisted). Attacks during your next action by your hero inflict an additional amount of damage equal to the amount your hero suffered (of one damage type).

name: Power Failure
text: React: Play when your super targets with an attack power, and discard 1 card: Turn off one toggle power of the attack's target.

name: Head Shot
text: Action: Discard 1 card: Target an opponent's power. End all effects of the power, then send it to its owner's hand (including enhancements).

name: Overworked
text: React: Play when an opponent declares a recharge action: Choose one of the player's powers. That power doesn't recharge.

name: Demoralize
text: React: Play when an inspiration is played: Cancel all effects of the inspiration.

name: Fighting Spirit
text: React: Play when your super hits with an attack action: Perform an attack action immediately after this one.

name: Expanded Mission
text: Action: Play a mission from your hand while there is a different one in play. Both missions stay in play until a new mission is played, or both missions are defeated. If both are defeated, move each mission to the super that defeated it.

name: Rikti Invasion
text: Action: Beginning with your supers and going clockwise, inflict 3 psychic damage on each super. This is not an attack and does not require an accuracy check.

name: Winterlord Attack
text: React: Play before this super performs an action: For 3 actions, all supers must discard a card to activate a power or to move.

name: Hallow's Eve Assault
text: React: Play when your super targets an attack on a super who is currently affected by a status effect: The attack's printed damage is doubled for this attack. You may play only one Hallow's Eve Assault per attack.

name: Temporary Power
text: Action: This super performs an Action printed on a power in your hand that you could put into play on this super. Discard the power.

name: Paragon Times Extra!
text: React: Play when your super inflicts 5 or more damage with an attack: This super permanently gains +1 accuracy and +1 damage per attack (each damage type). You may play only one Paragon Times Extra! per attack.

name: Fully Enhanced
text: React: Play when your super activates an attack power: This attack inflicts additional damage (choose one damage type) equal to the number of enhancements on this super's powers.

name: City of Power
text: Action: Put any number of powers into play from your hand, in any order.

name: Dramatic Improvement
text: Action: Heal one of your supers 3 hit points (4 if the super is a defender).

name: Building Rage
text: Action: Attacks during your next action inflict +2 damage of all types (+3 if this super is a blaster).

name: Uncanny Insight
text: Action: During your next action, your attacks have +3 accuracy, and you do not need to discard cards to chase or to activate attack powers.

name: Enraged
text: React: Play when your super suffers damage from an attack: Attacks by this super during your next action have +3 accuracy, and +2 damage (of each damage type). You may play only one Enraged per attack.

name: Cornered
text: React: Play when your super activates an attack power: Target an opponent's super who is fighting Run-n-Gun. Move the target to Toe-to-Toe. Your attack must target the super.

name: Self-Sacrifice
text: Action: Discard one of this super's powers from play: Inflict 3 smashing damage on any super. This is not an attack and does not require an accuracy check. For the rest of the game, you may not put another copy of that power into play.

name: Knock out of the Sky
text: React: Play when your super declares an action: Target a super with the flight travel power. For the next 3 actions, the target does not have flight. Inflict 1 smashing damage on the target. This is not an attack and does not require an accuracy check.

name: Fast Attack
text: React: Play when your super activates an attack power: If this super has the superspeed travel power, the attack gains +2 accuracy and inflicts +2 damage (choose one damage type).

name: Out of the Sun
text: React: Play when your super activates a melee attack power: If this super has the flight travel power, this attack inflicts additional smashing damage equal to the number of non-starting powers this super has in play. You may play only one Out of the Sun per attack.

name: Active Dodge
text: React: Play when your super is targeted with an attack: If this super has the superjump travel power, he gains a defense bonus against this attack equal to the number of powers he has in play.

name: Defensive Teleport
text: React: Play when your super is targeted by an attack: If this super has the teleport travel power, he gains +5 defense against this attack.

name: Simultaneous Upgrade
text: React: Play when you put a power or enhancement into play: Put a power or enhancement into play attached to your sidekick.

name: Quick Strike
text: React: Play when you put a power into play, and discard a card: Perform an action on the power.

name: Arcane Ritual
text: Action: Discard 2 cards: Rotate all of your powers to ready position.

name: Torn Asunder
text: Action: Discard a card: Beginning with you, each player must discard one of their powers from play.

name: Overwhelmed
text: React: Play when your super activates an attack power: Resistance has no effect against this attack.

name: Disrupted
text: React: Play when a super activates a ranged attack power: The attack is a changed to a melee attack.

name: Status Reflection
text: React: Play when your super is hit by an attack that inflicts a status effect, and discard 1 card: The status effect affects the attacking super instead.

name: Blunted Attack
text: React: Play when your super is targeted by a melee attack, and discard 1 card: The attack does half damage (of each damage type, rounded down). If this super is a controller, you do not need to discard a card as part of this card's cost.

name: Hard Crash
text: React: Play when a super declares an action that heals: The action does not heal.

name: Secret Power
text: Action: Put a power into play face-down. While it is face-down, it is not considered in play and may not be affected by any card or game effect. You may turn it face-up as an action, immediately before using an action or react on the power, or immediately before attaching an enhancement to it.

name: Christmas Gift
text: Action: Draw 4 cards. Discard 1 card.

name: Superior Tactics
text: React: Discard 1 card: Play an edge card from your discard pile as if it were in your hand, then remove it from the game. Play this card whenever the card from your discard pile could be played.

name: Inspired
text: You may discard this card as any type of Inspiration.

name: Ambush
text: Action: You may only play Ambush while a mission card is in play. The mission performs a ranged attack targeting a super, with accuracy equal to its defense. You may play edge cards and inspirations as if the mission were a super you controlled. The attack inflicts 3 smashing damage (5 smashing damage if the mission was played by the target's controller).

name: Bob and Weave
text: React: Play when your super is targeted by an attack: Gain +3 defense for this action.

name: Critical Strike
text: React: Play when your super activates an attack power: The power inflicts +1 damage (of each damage type), +2 damage if this super is a scrapper.

name: Focused
text: React: Play when your super targets with an attack power: Gain +4 accuracy for the attack.

name: Freedom!
text: React: Play when your super activates an attack power: You do not need to pay any discard costs for this attack (including the cost of the power, chasing, or any other card effect).

name: Ghost Ship Sighted
text: Action: Examine the top 8 cards of your deck. You may take any one of the cards into your hand. Shuffle the remaining cards into your deck.

name: Helpful Contact
text: React: Play when you defeat a mission: Name a mission. Search your deck then your discard pile for a copy of that mission, reveal it to your opponents, and put it in your hand. Shuffle your deck.

name: Learning Curve
text: React: Play when an opponent puts a power into play: Charge the Power 1 click (90 degrees clockwise).

name: Selfless Act
text: React: Play when your super is targeted by an action: Redirect the action to an allied sidekick unless the sidekick is also targeted by the action.

name: Advanced Programming
text: This power recharges 2 clicks (180 degrees) when it recharges. This power inflicts +2 damage (of each damage type) when it inflicts damage with an attack.
prereq: You may only attach this enhancement to a power with at least 2 enhancements attached.

name: Back Alley Brawn
text: This power inflicts +2 damage (of each damage type) when it inflicts damage with an attack.
prereq: You may only attach this enhancement to a power with Enhance Damage attached.

name: Enhance Accuracy
text: This power has +2 accuracy.

name: Enhance Damage
text: This power inflicts +2 damage (choose one damage type) when it inflicts damage with an attack.

name: Enhance Defense
text: This power provides an additional +1 defense when it provides defense.

name: Enhance Heal
text: This power heals +1 hit point when it heals. This does not affect powers that increase a healing effect.

name: Enhance Resistance
text: This power provides an additional +1 resistance when it provides resistance.

name: Amplify Debuff
text: When this power gives an accuracy penalty, it gives an additional -1 accuracy. When this power gives a defense penalty, it gives an additional -1 defense.

name: Increase Status
text: When this power creates a status effect, the status effect lasts for 1 additional action.

name: Odin's Breath
text: This power heals +2 hit points when it heals. This does not affect powers that increase a healing effect.
prereq: You may only attack this enhancement to a power with Enhance Heal attached.

name: Positron Precision
text: This power has +3 Accuracy. This power inflicts +1 damage (of each damage type) when it inflicts damage with an attack.
prereq: You may only attach this enhancement to a power with Enhance Accuracy attached.

name: Reduce Endurance Cost
text: When this power discards cards as a cost, the number of discards is reduced by one. This power does not count as a toggle towards your toggle limit.

name: Reduce Recharge
text: This power recharges 2 clicks (180 degrees) when it recharges.

name: Manticore's Will
text: This power has +3 accuracy. After you activate this power, draw 1 card.
prereq: You may only attach this enhancement to a power with at least 2 enhancements attached.

name: Statesman's Fury
text: This power inflicts +4 damage (of each damage type) when it inflicts damage with an attack.
prereq: You may only attach this enhancement to a power with at least 3 enhancements attached.

name: Synaptic Speed
text: This power has +2 accuracy. This power inflicts +2 damage (of each damage type) when it inflicts damage with an attack.
prereq: You may only attach this enhancement to a hero with completed missions.

name: Flower Knight
text: React: When Flower Knight activates an attack power, discard one of her powers in play: The attack gains +2 damage (of each damage type).

name: Fusillade
text: Fusillade's area attacks do +1 damage (of each damage type).

name: Bottle Rocket
text: React: When an ally hits with an attack, discard 1 card: Bottle Rocket may perform an attack action immediately after this one.

name: Conductress
text: React: When you put an Electrical Blast power into play on Conductress: Put an Ice Manipulation power into play.

name: Flux
text: React: When an opponent discards the last card from his hand as an effect of one of Flux's powers (direct effect or the payment of a cost): Attacks during your next action inflict +2 energy damage.

name: Paragon Blaster
text: When you reveal your hero, declare a primary (Assault Rifle, Electric Blast, Energy Blast, Fire Blast, Ice Blast, Sonic Attack or Archery) and a secondary (Devices, Energy Manipulation, Electric Manipulation, Fire Manipulation, or Ice Manipulation) powerset. You begin with 2 primary powers and 1 secondary power with a requirement of that powerset.

name: Pyrexiah
text: React: When Pyrexiah activates an attack power, discard a card: This attack inflicts 1 additional fire damage or 1 additional cold damage.

name: Synapse
text: Action: Discard 1 card: Target a player, who discards 2 random cards from his hand.

name: Trajectory
text: React: When an opponent discards a card as an effect of one of Trajectory's powers (direct effect or the payment of a cost), discard 1 card: Inflict 2 smashing damage on the opponent's super. This is not an attack, and does not require an accuracy check.

name: Tricksie
text: React: When a super targets an attack power, discard 1 of Tricksie's powers: Redirect the attack to another legal target that is not already a target of the attack.

name: Snowslide
text: React: When a super under a status effect is targeted by an attack power: The super has -3 defense for this attack.

name: Chain Reaction
text: Chain Reaction's attacks do +2 damage (of each damage type) to supers that are stunned or immobilized.

name: Polar Star
text: While Polar Star is fighting Toe-to-Toe, opponent's supers fighting Toe-to-Toe must discard 1 card to activate a power or to move.

name: Paragon Controller
text: When you reveal your hero, declare a primary (Earth Control, Fire Control, Gravity Control, Ice Control, Illusion Control, or Mind Control) and a secondary (Empathy, Radiation Emission, Force Field, Storm, Kinetics, Sonic Resonance, or Trickshot) powerset. You begin with 2 primary powers and 1 secondary power with a requirement of that powerset.

name: Sister Psyche
text: Action: Discard 1 card: Heal a super 3 hit points.

name: Lighthouse
text: React: When an attack targeting Lighthouse fails its accuracy check: Inflict 3 electrical damage on the attacker. This is not an attack and does not require an accuracy check.

name: Electronica
text: React: When an opponent's super moves: Inflict 1 energy damage on the super. This is not an attack and does not require an accuracy check.

name: Dynamique
text: React: When Dynamique targets an attack, discard 1 card: If the target's last attack targeting Dynamique did no damage, Dynamique's attack inflicts +2 damage of each damage type.

name: Regulus
text: React: When Regulus activates a Radiation Emission non-attack power: Regulus may take an archery power attack action after this action.

name: Radstorm
text: Opposing supers that are the target of one or more of Radstorm's toggles suffer +1 damage (of all damage types) from attacks.

name: Manticore
text: Manticore never discards cards due to an opponent's card effects (direct effects or additional costs).

name: Paragon Defender
text: When you reveal your hero, declare a primary (Dark Miasma, Empathy, Radiation Emission, Force Field, Storm, Kinetics, Sonic Resonance, or Trickshot) and a secondary (Dark Blast, Energy Blast, Electrical Blast, Psychic Blast, Radiation Blast, Sonic Attack, or Archery) powerset. You begin with 2 primary powers and 1 secondary power with a requirement of that powerset.

name: Positron
text: Action: Discard 1 card: Search your deck for any power with "Radiation" in the title, reveal it, and put it in your hand. Shuffle your deck.

name: Mynx
text: React: When Mynx activates an attack power, discard 1 card: The target may not increase his defense until after this attack.

name: Serpent Drummer
text: React: When Serpent Drummer targets a melee attack, discard 1 card: Serpent Drummer may target an additional super using the same combat tactic. The attack is an area attack.

name: Lady Grey
text: React: When Lady Grey inflicts 4 or more negative energy damage with an attack: Lady Grey heals 1 hit point.

name: Somber Warrior
text: React: When Somber Warrior is targeted by a ranged attack, discard 1 card: Somber Warrior gains resistance +2 to all damage types for this attack.

name: Stygian
text: React: When Stygian inflicts 2 or more negative energy damage with an attack: The target has -2 accuracy during his next action.

name: Night Strike
text: React: When Night Strike suffers damage: Night Strike's attacks gain +1 accuracy and inflict +1 lethal damage during your next action.

name: Ms. Liberty
text: When Ms. Liberty rests, she draws an additional card.

name: Paragon Scrapper
text: When you reveal your hero, declare a primary (Broadsword, Claws, Dark Melee, Katana, Martial Arts, or Spines) and a secondary (Dark Armor, Invulnerability, Regeneration, or Super Reflexes) powerset. You begin with 2 primary powers and 1 secondary power with a requirement of that powerset.

name: Infernal
text: React: When Infernal or an ally is targeted by an attack, suffer 1 fire damage: All targets of this attack gain +1 Defense for this attack.

name: Wasteland
text: React: When Wasteland is targeted by an attack, discard 1 card: The attack's printed damage is halved for this attack (of each type, rounded up).

name: Aesir
text: React: When Aesir suffers damage: Aesir's attacks inflict +2 lethal damage during your next action.

name: Caldera
text: Action: Discard 1 card: If Caldera is fighting Toe-to-Toe, inflict 2 fire damage on all opposing supers fighting Toe-to-Toe. This is not an attack and does not require an accuracy check.

name: Hero 1
text: React: When an ally using the same combat tactic as Hero 1 is targeted by an attack, suffer 2 energy damage: If the action is not targeting Hero 1 and he is a legal target, redirect it to Hero 1.

name: Paragon Tanker
text: When you reveal your hero, declare a primary (Fiery Aura, Ice Armor, Invulnerability, or Stone Armor) and a secondary (Battle Axe, Fiery Melee, Ice Melee, Energy Melee, Stone Melee, Super Strength, or Mace) powerset. You begin with 2 primary powers and 1 secondary power with a requirement of that powerset.

name: Statesman
text: Statesman has resistance 1 to all damage types.

name: The Tournament
text:
Threat: All supers have -1 Defense.
Defeat: Discard 1 of your powers from play.
Reward: All supers have +1 Defense.

name: Sky Raider's Time Bomb
text: Place 10 tokens onto this mission when it enters play.

name: Portal of Thorns
text:
Threat: Resistance does not reduce damage.
Defeat: Discard 4 cards from your hand.
Reward: All resistances are +1.

name: Earn Your Cape
text:
Threat: Area attacks inflict -1 damage (of each damage type).
Defeat: Discard 2 enhancements from your powers.
Reward: Area attacks inflict +2 damage (choose one damage type).

name: Tsoo Tattoo Parlor
text:
Threat: Ranged attacks have -2 accuracy.
Defeat: Charge 2 of your non-continuous powers by 2 clicks (180 degrees).
Reward: Melee attacks by supers using Toe-to-Toe do not have to discard to chase.

name: Defeat Teh PwNxx0rz!
text:
Threat: Players may perform "Action: Inflict 3 lethal damage on each super in play. This is not an attack and doesn't require an accuracy check."
Reward: All super heal to full health.

name: Flux's Trust
text:
Threat: Attacks do 1 less damage (of each damage type), minimum one.
Reward: Players may retrieve "Outcast Diversion" from their deck or discard pile. Attacks do +1 damage (of each damage type).

name: Outcast Diversion
text: Can only be played if "Flux's Trust" has been played.

name: Frostfire's Lair
text: Can only be played if "Outcast Diversion" has been played.

name: The Diseased Dead
text:
Threat: After an attack is targeted, the target's defense cannot be increased.
Reward: Players may retrieve "Victim of the Plague" from their deck or discard. After a super is hit by an attack, he draws a card.

name: Victim of the Plague
text: Can only be played if "The Diseased Dead" has been played.

name: Source of Infection
text: Can only be played if "Victim of the Plague" has been played. Turn off all toggles when played.

name: Save the Fortune Teller
text:
Threat: Supers must discard 1 card to activate a melee attack power.
Reward: Ranged attacks have +2 accuracy.

name: Bind Demon
text: React: Activate when Infernal suffers damage from an attack: Infernal suffers 1 fire damage. Perform an attack action targeting the attacker.

name: Feral Flurry
text: Action: Melee attack. Inflict 4 lethal damage. Feral Flurry can target supers using any combat tactic without chasing.

name: Summon Ancestor
text: Action: Ranged Attack. Inflict 5 lethal damage. When you activate Summon Ancestor, you may discard 1 card to have it charge 1 click (90 degrees) instead of 2 clicks (180 degrees).

name: Teleport Arrow
text: Action: Ranged Attack. Inflict 2 lethal damage. Knockdown the target (during his next action, the target must discard 2 cards to activate a power or to move). Teleport Arrow checks accuracy against the target's unmodified Defense, ignoring bonuses and penalties.

name: Aid from the Fae
text: React: Activate when Hero 1 suffers damage, discard 1 card: Reduce the damage from one damage type by 2 (minimum 1).

name: Rapid Fire
text: Action: Ranged area attack. Target all opposing supers using the same combat tactic. Inflict 1 fire damage and 1 lethal damage on each target.

name: Equinox
text: Action: Ranged attack. Inflict 2 fire damage and 2 cold damage.

name: Skyrockets in Flight
text: Action: Ranged attack. Inflict 8 energy damage minus the number of cards in the target's hand (minimum 1).

name: Ice Spark
text: Action: Discard 1 card: Ranged Attack. Inflict 2 energy damage and 1 cold damage. The target must discard 1 card. For 1 action, the target must discard a card to activate a power, or to move.

name: Amplification Band
text: Action: Ranged attack. Inflict 4 energy damage. The target must discard 1 card. Attacks during your next action inflict +2 damage (of each damage type).

name: Gravity Arrow
text: Action: Discard 1 card: Ranged attack. Inflict 2 lethal damage and 2 smashing damage. Knockdown the target (during his next action, the target must discard 2 cards to activate a power, or to move).

name: Mind Shaft
text: Action: Ranged attack. Inflict smashing damage equal to the number of powers the target has in play.

name: Glacial Shift
text: Action: Discard 1 card: Ranged attack. Inflict 4 cold damage. Stun the target for 2 actions. Turn off the target's toggles.

name: Critical Reactor
text: Action: Ranged attack. Inflict 2 smashing damage. Stun the target for 1 action. Turn off the target's toggles. You may perform an attack action after this one.

name: Icy Star
text: Action: Ranged attack. Inflict 2 cold damage. Stun the target for 1 action. Turn off the target's toggles.

name: Shield of Light
text: React: Activate when Lighthouse or an ally using the same combat tactic is targeted by a melee attack: Melee attack targeting the attacker. Inflict 2 smashing damage and 1 energy damage. The attacker must discard 2 cards or his attack is canceled.

name: Whistler
text: Action: Name Toe-to-Toe or Run-n-Gun. Until Whistler readies, opposing supers using that combat tactic suffer -2 accuracy and -2 defense.

name: Radiation Force
text: React: Activate when Dynamique is targeted by an attack: Gain +3 defense for this attack. If the attack misses, inflict 3 energy damage on the attacker. This is not an attack and does not require an accuracy check.

name: Arcing Missle
text: Action: Ranged attack. Inflict 2 smashing damage and 1 energy damage. If Regulus or the target is fighting Run-n-Gun, the target has -2 accuracy for 2 actions and knockdown the target (during his next action, the target must discard 2 cards to activate a power or to move).

name: Radiation Storm
text: While Radiation Storm is on, supers that target Radstorm with an attack suffer -1 Accuracy and -2 Defense until after their next action.

name: Mindrider
text: Action: Ranged attack. Inflict 3 psychic damage. Rotate one of the target's powers 1 click (90 degrees) in either direction.

name: Snake Spirit
text: Action: Ranged Attack. Inflict 3 lethal damage. For 2 actions, the target must discard 1 card to activate a power, or to move.

name: Aging Touch
text: Action: Melee attack. Inflict 4 negative energy damage. For the next 2 actions, the target does -2 damage of each damage type (minimum 1) with attacks.

name: Knowledge of the Ages
text: Action: Melee attack. Inflict negative energy damage equal to half the number of cards in your hand (rounded down).

name: From Beyond
text: Action: Stygian suffers 1 negative energy damage: Melee attack. Inflict 3 negative energy damage and 1 smashing damage.

name: Hit and Run
text: Action: Melee attack. Inflict 4 lethal damage. Night Strike may move Toe-to-Toe or Run-n-Gun.

name: Survival of the Fittest
text: Wasteland has resistance 2 to all damage types while he has more cards in his hand than the attacker.

name: Blood of Giants
text: React: Activate when Aesir suffers damage, and discard 1 card: Reduce the damage to 1 point (of each damage type).

name: Blazing Speed
text: While Blazing Speed is on, Caldera has +2 Defense.

name: Aimed Arrow
text: Action: For your next 2 actions, this super's attacks have +4 accuracy, and +2 damage (of each damage type).

name: Aimed Shot
text: Action: Ranged attack. Inflict 4 lethal damage.

name: Blazing Arrow
text: Action: Ranged attack. Inflict 2 lethal damage and 2 fire damage.

name: Explosive Arrow
text: Action: Ranged area attack. Target all opposing supers using the same combat style. Inflict 4 lethal damage and knockdown each target (during his next action, the target must discard 2 cards to activate a power or to move).

name: Snap Shot
text: Action: Ranged attack. Inflict 3 lethal damage.

name: Stunning Shot
text: Action: Ranged attack. Inflict 5 lethal damage. Stun the target for 3 actions. Turn off the target's toggles.

name: Beheader
text: Action: Melee attack. Inflict 6 lethal damage.

name: Chop
text: Action: Melee attack. Inflict 5 lethal damage.

name: Gash
text: Action: Discard 1 card: Melee attack. Inflict 5 lethal damage.

name: Pendulum
text: Action: Melee area attack. Target a super and an ally using the same combat tactic. Inflict 8 lethal damage to each target.

name: Swoop
text: Action: Melee attack. Inflict 6 lethal damage. Knockdown the target (during his next action, the target must discard 2 cards to activate a power or to move).

name: Whirling Axe
text: Action: Discard 1 card: Melee area attack. Target all opposing supers using the same combat tactic. Inflict 6 lethal damage on each target.

name: Eviscerate
text: Action: Discard 1 card: Melee area attack. Target a super and one ally using the same combat tactic. Inflict 8 lethal damage on each target.

name: Focus
text: Action: Ranged attack. Target a super. You may discard a card to target another super using the same combat tactic (Focus becomes an area attack). Inflict 5 lethal damage on each target.

name: Follow Up
text: Action: Melee attack. Inflict 3 lethal damage, and your next action inflicts +3 damage (choose one damage type).

name: Slash
text: Action: Discard 1 card: Melee attack. Inflict 5 lethal damage.

name: Spin
text: Action: Discard 1 card: Melee area attack. Target all opposing supers who are using the same combat taactic. Inflict 5 lethal damage on each target.

name: Swipe
text: Action: Melee attack. Inflict 4 lethal damage.

name: Cloak of Fear
text: While Cloak of Fear is on, players must discard 2 cards to target this super with a melee attack.

name: Dark Embrace
text: While Dark Embrace is on, this super has Resistance 1 to smashing, lethal and negative energy damage.

name: Dark Regeneration
text: Action: Discard 2 cards: Melee area attack. Target all opposing supers using the same combat tactic. Inflict 2 negative energy damage on each target. This super heals 3 hit points for each target hit.

name: Death Shroud
text: While Death Shroud is on, you may perform: "React: When this super is hit by a melee attack: Inflict 2 negative energy damage on the attacker. This is not an attack and does not require an accuracy check."

name: Murky Cloud
text: While Murky Cloud is on, this super has Resistance 2 to fire, cold, energy, and negative energy damage.

name: Soul Transfer
text: React: Activate before this super is reduced to zero hit points: This super not defeated. Instead, he has 8 hit points plus 2 additional hit points for each opposing super. All damage being suffered is ignored. Discard your hand and draw cards equal to the number of opposing supers. Soul Transfer may be used only once per game.

name: Dark Consumption
text: Action: Melee area attack. Target all opposing supers using the same combat tactic. Inflict 2 smashing damage and 2 negative energy damage on each target. Draw 2 cards for each super hit with Dark Consumption (up to 4 cards).

name: Shadow Maul
text: Action: Discard 1 card: Melee area attack. Target 1 super and 1 ally using the same combat tactic. Inflict 2 smashing damage and 1 negative energy damage on each target.

name: Shadow Punch
text: Action: Melee attack. Inflict 1 smashing damage and 2 negative energy damage. The target has -1 accuracy during his next action.

name: Siphon Life
text: Action: Melee attack. Inflict 5 negative energy damage. This super heals 3 hit points. The target has -1 accuracy during his next action.

name: Soul Drain
text: Action: Melee area attack. Target all opposing supers using the same combat tactic. Inflict 4 negative energy damage on each target. For your next 2 actions, you have +1 accuracy and +2 damage (of all types) for each super hit with Soul Drain.

name: Touch of Fear
text: Action: Melee attack. Inflict 2 negative energy damage, and the target has -3 accuracy for two actions.

name: Auto Turret
